manifest.name: Hall Sensor
manifest.summary: Reads the Hall-effect sensor built into the ESP32 chip, averages the noisy value, and lights the onboard LED when a magnet comes near the module.

components.name: Built-in Hall-effect sensor
components.note: Inside the ESP32 chip, under the metal shield of the NanoKit-iM module; nothing is wired. hallRead() measures through ADC1 channels 0 and 3, i.e. NanoKit Pin 5 / GPIO36 and NanoKit Pin 4 / GPIO39, which must stay unconnected while the sensor is used.

components.name: Onboard LED
components.note: Lights while the averaged reading differs from the baseline by more than the detection threshold.

pins.note: Onboard LED on the PWM_OUT0 pin

findings.message: GPIO2 (NanoKit Pin 17): must be low or floating at boot for download mode; the onboard LED and a signal output are acceptable loads.
